chapter_1.title: First Night
chapter_1.description: Mara arrives at Exit 13 for her first shift. Learn the ropes. Everything seems normal.

chapter_2.title: Settling In
chapter_2.description: The routine begins to feel familiar, but small things are wrong. The radio picks up strange signals. A guest asks for Room 4.

chapter_3.title: Static
chapter_3.description: Power problems. A police deputy starts asking questions. The CCTV shows things that aren't there. Mara finds records of the Mile 87 pileup.

chapter_4.title: Frequency
chapter_4.description: The radio voice speaks directly to Mara. The owner grows hostile. Guests appear who match descriptions from the pileup victims list.

chapter_5.title: Mile 87
chapter_5.description: The truth about Exit 13 emerges. The service plaza exists as a waystation for the lost. Mara must decide what she is willing to accept.

chapter_6.title: Last Shift
chapter_6.description: The final night. Everything converges. Mara's choices determine which ending unfolds.

survival_partial_truth.title: The Long Road
survival_partial_truth.conditions: Moderate truth score, high composure, protected guests
survival_partial_truth.description: Mara survives with partial understanding. She leaves Exit 13 knowing something is wrong but unable to fully explain it. She drives away at dawn. The service plaza remains, waiting for the next auditor.

profitable_corruption.title: Open for Business
profitable_corruption.conditions: High profit score, low guest protection, trusted the owner
profitable_corruption.description: Mara accepts the nature of Exit 13 and becomes complicit. The stranded keep coming. The register keeps ringing. She tells herself it's just a job.

self_destructive_obsession.title: Static
self_destructive_obsession.conditions: High truth score, low composure, ignored self-care
self_destructive_obsession.description: Mara uncovers everything but loses herself in the process. She becomes another echo on the highway, another voice on the radio, another name in the old records.

true_confrontation.title: Clear Frequency
true_confrontation.conditions: Maximum truth, high composure, all evidence collected, trusted the radio voice
true_confrontation.description: Mara confronts the source of the loop. She releases the stranded travelers, closes the frequency, and walks away whole. Exit 13 goes dark. The highway is just a highway again.
